name: Amazon CMH1 Fulfillment Center Etna OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Both public-road entrances (signalized NE drive off National Rd SW and the NW dock drive) are open: 2024-2025 Street View and z19 satellite show no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at either road. Open Amazon FC campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at either entrance. The NE entrance Street View shows an open multi-lane internal road straight into employee parking and the building, no booth beside the lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all; check-in is handled internally at the yard, not at a road gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved internal aprons and the SE drop yard provide ample interior holding before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The NE entrance drive runs ~250m from National Rd to the parking/yard, easily holding 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate property entrances off National Rd SW: a signalized main drive on the NE (~39.9563,-82.7099) and a NW dock drive (~39.9548,-82.7138). Lane counts approximate from overhead.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance aprons and multi-lane internal roads leave ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous trailer rows backed into the entire SW/west building face (two long dock banks, 60+ positions per z19 crops) plus additional doors; total well into 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated SE drop yard with ~40-50 angled trailer stalls plus long dock-side trailer rows; combined trailer parking is 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (long SW/west dock banks vs. SE drop-yard-served face); medium confidence on the ship/receive split.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town/rural setting flanked by farmland and I-70; nearest fabric is a small residential pocket and the Etna industrial corridor. Per rubric, choose Rural when torn.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single very large multi-story fulfillment building; the SE area is a drop yard, not a separate structure.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Estimate combines SE drop-yard angled stalls and dock-side trailer rows; approximate from overhead imagery.

citations.claim: Amazon's own tour portal lists CMH1 Etna OH as a currently operating FC with bookable in-person tours
Pataskala Area Chamber lists Amazon Fulfillment CMH1 as an active member business at 11999 National Rd SW

verification.rationale: Amazon-owned tour portal lists CMH1 as operating FC + active careers + chamber listing; closure gauntlet returned only unrelated Ohio janitorial-contractor layoffs at other sites.
